description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment plus a parking post at the dry lake. It is located in a new and very high-quality building. It is organized in a living room and kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. The interior environment is invested by an architect with quality materials, fully furnished and never lived in before. The price also includes the parking post at -2. It has a certificate of ownership. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us.
